data.cultural_impact: The name Periyasamy holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism. "Periya" translates to "great" or "large," while "asamy" means "master" or "lord." With this definition, the name Periyasamy is given to a person who is considered to be a great master or guru, a wise and knowledgeable individual revered and respected within the community. These leaders exude a powerful, charismatic presence that commands respect and attention. In Hindu teachings, the guru is not only a mentor, but also an embodiment of divine wisdom and guidance, playing a vital role in the spiritual growth of their disciples.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Periyasamy can be understood through the meaning of its constituent parts. "Peri" represents the infinite, transcendental consciousness that transcends the physical body and the material world. "Ya" denotes someone who has realized and identified with this higher consciousness, becoming "one with the absolute." "Samy" means self, suggesting a person who has achieved a state of enlightened self-realization. Thus, a person named Periyasamy is one who has immersed in the inner wisdom and knowledge, embracing a deep understanding of the Self and ultimate reality. Through their connection to the supreme consciousness, individuals with this name are believed to possess great spiritual power and knowledge, capable of guiding others on their spiritual journeys.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Maya Periyasamy in Kolkata, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Periyasamy, which means "Great Master". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Great Master" symbolizes One who possesses the great knowledge and power of a master. In Hindu spirituality, bearing the name Periyasamy serves as a constant reminder of one's dharma and connection to Hindu values of great master.
